notes: LOCKDOWN layout (Task 6). Frame coordinates in metres: u runs along the main street (west -> east), v runs uphill (south -> north). world_x = cx + u*cos(rot) - v*sin(rot), world_z = cz + u*sin(rot) + v*cos(rot), with rot in degrees (negative = clockwise from true east). World = local TM, +X east, +Z true north, origin = real village centre.

landmarks.name: Main street
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real through road: 6-9 m, climbing west, two bends kept so there is no full-length sightline; 700 m condensed to 150 m.

landmarks.name: Plateia
landmarks.label: REAL
landmarks.note: At the real centre: memorial terrace, kafeneio and mini-market within 30 m where the street widens. Widened a little for play.

landmarks.name: War memorial terrace
landmarks.label: REAL
landmarks.note: Real stepped terrace on the uphill side; high ground over the plateia. Inscription illegible, no names.

landmarks.name: Kafeneio
landmarks.label: REAL
landmarks.note: Real beige corner building, arched windows; tables on the street.

landmarks.name: Mini-market
landmarks.label: REAL
landmarks.note: Real stone-and-plaster shop under a deep balcony; generic sign.

landmarks.name: The ravine
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real tree-lined gully comes down from the rock here; in reality it meets the street 30 m further east and turns along it. Straightened and carried on south across the lower lane.

landmarks.name: Main bridge
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real road crosses the gully; made a visible bridge with parapets (Flag B).

landmarks.name: The Skeleton
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real exploded one-storey house, moved here (its real spot does not decide this). Neutral, next to Flag B; front pushed further; roof by scaffolding.

landmarks.name: Rock-edge rooftops
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real flat-roof core under the rock; pulled close to the ravine as the power position.

landmarks.name: Upper rock road
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real dirt road at the foot of the bare rock, about 80 m higher in reality; pulled down to make the upper lane.

landmarks.name: Unfinished frames
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real row of concrete-frame buildings on the west main street, condensed to two.

landmarks.name: Empty lot with fig
landmarks.label: REAL
landmarks.note: Real dry-grass lot with fig, firewood and the old stove, from the west end of the street.

landmarks.name: Community office
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real office with rooftop loudspeakers at the west junction, 160 m further west in reality; plaques generic.

landmarks.name: Small bridge & dry stream
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real galvanised-railing bridge over the dry stream at the west junction; brought into the spawn edge.

landmarks.name: Gravel yard & beehives
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real yard with trucks and beehive stacks under the cliff.

landmarks.name: West clan courtyard
landmarks.label: INVENTED
landmarks.note: Composite: pergola, compact pickups, wood-carving workshop. Never one real house.

landmarks.name: East clan courtyard
landmarks.label: INVENTED
landmarks.note: Composite in the village style, hay bales and sacks.

landmarks.name: Aloni (threshing floor)
landmarks.label: INVENTED
landmarks.note: Circular stone threshing floor with a carob tree: very Cretan, none recorded at this spot.

landmarks.name: Lamp-lit east entry
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real paver street with pink sidewalk, lantern lamps and guardrail from the east entry.

landmarks.name: Church & chapel
landmarks.label: ADAPTED
landmarks.note: Real stone church with bell tower and chapel, ~65 m further downhill in reality; moved up to the lower lane (Flag A). Paved yard, pithoi.

landmarks.name: Olive press
landmarks.label: INVENTED
landmarks.note: Small stone press shed on real-style garden terraces (Flag C).

landmarks.name: Garden terraces & olives
landmarks.label: REAL
landmarks.note: Real south-side terraces, dry-stone walls, olives and tall trees.

landmarks.name: Primary school
landmarks.label: REAL
landmarks.note: Real school at the east bend, outside the play area (scenery only).
